source.source_locator: 教則 第6章 6.1「飛行計画」(1)飛行計画策定時の確認事項

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: 一時的な飛行規制は、予定経路と日時に結び付けて計画段階で確認する。
evidence.tested_misconception: 通常飛行可能な空域なら一時規制は運航開始後の確認でよい。
evidence.reasoning_path: time-specific route -> temporary restriction check -> planning constraint -> go/no-go

collision.note: LOW。Rulesの許可・承認要件そのものではなく、Risk Managementとして日時と経路に一時規制確認を結び付けるplanning decisionを問う。

independent_review.rationale: 6.1 supports checking planned route/time for temporary restrictions; Q091 gives such a constraint as already established.

director_adjudication.rationale: Independent reviewer evidence is source-consistent and correctly distinguishes integration/decision-boundary variants from exact semantic collisions.
